nodes.name: La-NMS@NF Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: (NH₄)₆Mo₇O₂₄·4H₂O (58 mg), sodium acetate (41 mg) and thioacetamide (134 mg) were prepared into a 30 mL homogeneous aqueous solution, where different amounts of lanthanum nitrate (La(NO₃)₃) were added according to La:Mo ratios of 1%, 3%, 5%, 7%. Pretreated NFs were added to the mixed solution which was transferred to a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and reacted at 180°C for 16 h. The obtained black samples (La1-NMS@NF, La3-NMS@NF, La5-NMS@NF, La7-NMS@NF) were washed several times with water/ethanol and vacuum dried at 50°C overnight.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows characteristic peaks of Ni₃S₂ at 21.8°, 31.2°, 37.8°, 47.9°, 50.1°, 55.2° and Ni at 44.3°, 51.7°, 76.1° for both NMS@NF and La-NMS@NF; no new phases from La doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern (Figure 1b) shows the crystal phase information of NMS@NF and La-NMS@NF with different La doping amounts.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows NMS@NF has network structure of messy nanosheets; La-NMS@NF evolves to nanoflower-like structure with smaller nanospheres at 3% La doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 1c, Ni₃S₂/MoS₂ grows on nickel foam with a network structure formed by assembling messy nanosheets. The morphology also varies with the doping amount of La.

nodes.characterization_summary: HR-TEM confirms MoS₂/Ni₃S₂ hetero-interfaces in hierarchical structure; lattice distance of 0.62 nm matches MoS₂ (002) plane and 0.23 nm belongs to Ni₃S₂ (021) planes; FFT confirms both phases; lattice defects observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: By observing the high-resolution TEM images in Figure 2b, the MoS₂/Ni₃S₂ hetero-interfaces exist in the hierarchical structure... The lattice fringes of 0.23 nm belong to (0 2 1) crystal planes of Ni₃S₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM image with EDX mapping shows uniform elemental distribution of Mo, Ni, S, O, and La across La-NMS@NF catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy-dispersive X-ray spectrum (EDX) of the La-NMS@NF catalyst (Figure 2d) reveals the uniform distribution of elements including Ni, Mo, S, O, and La... HAADF-STEM picture of La-NMS@NF catalyst and EDX mapping images.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms presence of Ni, Mo, S, C, O, La in La-NMS@NF; Mo⁶⁺ at 232.3/235.4 eV, Mo⁴⁺ shifts 0.3 eV lower in La-NMS@NF; Ni²⁺ shifts 0.3 eV higher; S 2p shifts 0.14 eV higher; La 3d₅/₂ at 839.1 eV confirms La-S.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) spectra (Figure S4a, Supporting Information) indicates the presence of Ni, Mo, S, C, O, and La elements in La-NMS@NF.
